about: A request to Friday; after her answer the same person asks a follow-up with no name ('And what are they called?'): it is for her, and she answers it.

lines.say: Friday, how many agents come with a new workspace?

notes: Leonardo is in the meeting and says nothing, so the follow-up is not for her just because nobody else is there. The follow-up is at a fixed 55 s: if the first answer is not out by then (answer_contains ... before 1 fails), the follow-up was not a follow-up and the other verdicts do not count.

expect.why: the first answer, before the follow-up (this also proves the script timing held)
the follow-up continues the exchange with Friday: it is a request to her
the follow-up is answered: the roles or the names (she was asked for them)
one agent answers the follow-up, not several
no sentence twice; the short fixed acknowledgement is said once per request
2 acknowledgements + 2 answers; the list of six may take a few lines
internal names (the agents' own names were asked for here)
